svg.title: SEP testbench architecture
svg.desc: Agents drive sep_wrapper through the CPU load/store port, the SMN inbound port, the SPI pads, JTAG, clock and reset, entropy noise and backdoor image loads. Monitors tap those paths and the internal fabric, and an analysis path carries what they observe to the scoreboards, which compare it with goldens and decide the verdict.
svg.text: analysis path: items, records, probe samples
